We have considered the submissions of the parties and perused the documents available on record. According to the Petitioner, the Project has been affected by Force Majeure events and the cost of construction has escalated due to the Change in Law events enumerated in paragraphs 7 and 8 above. The Petitioner has submitted that works in relation to the Kasargode S/s and Line Bays and Bus Bar Extension at UPCL switchyard have been substantially completed, and the Foundation and Erection Works for the UK Line have also been partially completed. Considerable funds have already been spent by the Petitioner to implement the Project. 16. Respondents Karnataka Escoms and KSEBL submitted that the Petition is not maintainable. The Respondents, vide common submissions, have disputed the claims related to Force Majeure and Change in Law, stating that such claims should be substantiated with the actual data, typically available only after achieving the commissioning/COD. Premature claims, filed before COD, are speculative and lack the necessary evidentiary support, thereby deserving rejection at the threshold itself. 18. We have considered the submissions of Petitioner and Respondents. It is observed that the Petitioner has claimed that various elements of the Project are affected by force majeure events, and such events are still continuing. It is observed that the events cited above are still continuing, and the Petitioner has approached the Commission for a declaration of these events as force majeure events and requested an extension of the SCOD of the Project, in advance. The Petitioner has also sought an in-principle approval for the alleged Change in Law events. We are of the view that since the project has not been completed by the Petitioner till date and is still under implementation, it would not be appropriate to take any view at this stage on the claimed Change in Law and force majeure issues and the extension of SCOD. After completing the project, the Petitioner is at liberty to approach the Commission to seek appropriate relief for a Change in Law and Force Majeure in accordance with law under the provisions of the TSA and other applicable provisions of the Law, Rules, and Regulations. ================================================================================ **Order in Petition No. 303/MP/2024** ================================================================================ **Order in Petition No. 303/MP/2024**
